scope.meaning: bounded source-conditioned forward signed inference; factual-world truth separate; unsupported positive natural example remains a visible generalization gap

aliases.SUPPORTED: positive target support only in every measured reading
aliases.REFUTED: negative target support only in every measured reading
aliases.CONFLICT: positive and negative target support within a reading
aliases.UNKNOWN: no target support in either direction or unresolved/unlicensed input; parse evidence distinguished
aliases.DISAGREEMENT: different per-reading truth statuses, without treating cross-reading opposition as same-reading conflict
